from.place: Proof, passage from a finite affine etale covering family to its disjoint union: base change the coproduct decomposition along an arbitrary scheme over X

title: Base change of a finite coproduct of schemes
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $(u_i:U_i\to X)_{i\in I}$ be a finite family of morphisms of schemes, and let $V=\coprod_{i\in I}U_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family], with coprojections $\iota_i:U_i\to V$ and the induced morphism $u:V\to X$ ($u\circ\iota_i=u_i$). For every morphism $t:T\to X$, the morphism of schemes over $T$ $$\coprod_{i\in I}(T\times_XU_i)\longrightarrow T\times_XV$$ (fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product]) whose restriction to the summand indexed by $i$ is $\mathrm{id}_T\times_X\iota_i$ is an isomorphism. In particular, under this isomorphism the projection to $T$ restricts on the summand indexed by $i$ to the projection $T\times_XU_i\to T$, and the projection to $V$ restricts to $\iota_i$ composed with the projection $T\times_XU_i\to U_i$.
